assets.name: hero-botanical
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium editorial hero image for a warm, trustworthy acupuncture and Chinese medicine practice website.
Primary request: a beautiful restrained botanical still life, a dark olive-jade handmade ceramic vase holding one delicate ginkgo branch, on rumpled natural ivory linen against a warm cream plaster wall. The ginkgo leaves are elegant fan shapes, botanical and graceful.
Style/medium: realistic painterly editorial illustration with refined visible brush texture, sophisticated contemporary fine-art still life. Full-bleed rectangular composition, no vignette, not cartoon. Subtle artfulness rather than photography or a fake clinical setting.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 canvas, approximately 1536 by 1024 pixels. Vase and botanical branch grouped near the center-right, comfortably framed inside the central half so the image also supports a portrait crop. Generous quiet space around the silhouette. Restrained close still life, not a room scene.
Lighting/mood: warm side sunlight, soft botanical shadows on plaster, welcoming contemplative calm.
Color palette: earthy deep jade and olive, warm ivory, muted sage, a tiny natural clay warmth. No bright accents.
Materials/textures: tactile matte glazed ceramics, linen weave, chalky plaster, precise delicate leaves.
Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermark, no borders, no medicines, no incense, no candles, no people, no decorative mandalas, no excessive objects.
